result.title: MHVF: Training-Free GUI Grounding via Verification-Guided Multi-Hypothesis Search
result.summary: GUI grounding enables web agents to translate natural-language instructions into actionable interface locations. However, dense layouts and small, visually similar controls can lead models toward plausible but incorrect elements, while refinement around a single prediction may leave alternative targets unexplored. We propose the Multi-Hypothesis Verification Framework (MHVF) for training-free GUI grounding. It combines multi-hypothesis exploration with local visual verification using a single pretrained vision-language model. To explore alternative targets, MHVF constructs spatial hypotheses from multiple full-screen predictions and examines the corresponding regions through zoomed re-localization. To resolve ambiguity among the resulting candidates, it verifies their agreement with the instruction in marked local views. Verification scores then guide a second round of local search and rank candidates retained from both search levels for final selection. Experiments with five general-purpose and GUI-specific models across eight benchmark settings demonstrate improvements in grounding accuracy in most settings. MHVF improves UI-Venus-Ground-7B by 4.3 and 2.1 percentage points on Mind2Web and VisualWebBench, respectively, and raises Qwen2.5-VL-7B's accuracy on ScreenSpot-Pro from 23.6% to 53.6%.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的多假设验证框架 MHVF 用于 GUI grounding：从多次全屏预测构造空间假设，借缩放的局部视图重新定位，并在标记局部视图中验证候选与指令的一致性，用验证分驱动第二轮局部搜索并对两级候选排序。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「多假设＋视觉证据筛选」这一兴趣点：其验证分驱动的第二轮搜索与候选排序可供核查 GET EVIDENCE 与停止决策的收益成本，但假设与验证都在文本坐标空间而非 latent 状态，能否迁移到内部推理状态需读原文判断。
